name: Korean

tutor.name: Min
tutor.personality: warm, upbeat, explains Hangul logic clearly, uses natural Korean expressions, encouraging with 잘했어요 and 화이팅

genderNotes: Korean uses politeness levels (존댓말/반말) rather than gendered speech. Formality matters more than gender.
notes: Hangul is a scientific alphabet invented in 1443 by King Sejong. Each block represents a syllable composed of consonants and vowels. Learnable in a few hours.
